title: Screenshot Pro
description: A polished in-game screenshot manager: gallery, albums, tags, favorites, trash, search and a fullscreen viewer.
body:
# Screenshot Pro

**Screenshot Pro** is a polished, client-side screenshot manager for Minecraft that lives inside the game. Browse, search, organize, and view your screenshots without ever alt-tabbing to a file explorer.

It is built for **Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.2, and 26.2** on the Fabric loader and feels like a native part of the game.

> Press **M** in game to open the manager, or use the button added to the pause menu.

---

## Screenshots

![The Gallery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devxkamlesh/screenshot-pro/main/src/main/resources/assets/screenshots/img_1.png "The Gallery")
*The Gallery: a scrollable grid of thumbnails with a live dashboard showing total screenshots, storage used, favorites, and albums.*

![Fullscreen Viewer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devxkamlesh/screenshot-pro/main/src/main/resources/assets/screenshots/img_2.png "Fullscreen Viewer")
*Fullscreen Viewer: mouse-wheel zoom, drag-to-pan, next and previous navigation, and an information overlay.*

![Rename](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devxkamlesh/screenshot-pro/main/src/main/resources/assets/screenshots/img_3.png "Rename")
*Rename: change a screenshot's name in place from a simple in-game dialog.*

![Pause Menu Access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devxkamlesh/screenshot-pro/main/src/main/resources/assets/screenshots/img_4.png "Pause Menu Access")
*Pause Menu Access: open the manager straight from the in-game pause menu.*

---

## Overview

Screenshot Pro reads your existing `screenshots` folder and presents it as a fast, organized gallery. Nothing is moved or modified until you ask for it. All metadata such as favorites, tags, and albums is stored alongside your screenshots, and deleting is non-destructive by default through a built-in trash.

---

## Features

### Gallery

- Grid and list views with smooth scrolling
- Asynchronous thumbnail loading that keeps the game responsive
- A dashboard showing total screenshots, storage used, favorite count, and albums
- Sorting by *newest*, *oldest*, *name*, or *file size*

### Search and Filters

- Search by filename, date, tags, or album with instant filtering
- Quick date filters: Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, This Month, This Year
- A Favorites filter and a dedicated Trash view

### Organization

- One-click favorites
- Tags and custom albums per screenshot
- A trash system with restore and configurable auto-empty, so a misclick never means a permanent loss

### Fullscreen Viewer

- Next and previous navigation
- Mouse-wheel zoom and drag to pan
- Fit, 100 percent, 200 percent, and 400 percent presets
- An information overlay with resolution, file size, and date
- Full keyboard control

### Bulk Tools

- Multi-select with **Ctrl+Click**, range select with **Shift+Click**, plus Select All and Clear
- Delete, favorite, share, and export all operate on the current selection
- Export any selection, or your favorites, to a ZIP archive
- Copy file paths to the clipboard
- Rename screenshots in place
- Open the screenshots folder in your operating system file browser

### Settings

Thumbnail size, grid columns, cache size, background and lazy loading, custom screenshot and trash directories, theme, and trash auto-empty are all adjustable from an in-game settings screen.

---

## Controls

- **Open the Screenshot Manager** — `M` (rebindable in Options, then Controls)
- **Select an item** — Click
- **Multi-select** — `Ctrl` + Click
- **Range select** — `Shift` + Click
- **Open in viewer** — Double-click or right-click
- **Viewer: navigate** — Left and right arrow keys
- **Viewer: zoom** — Mouse wheel
- **Viewer: pan** — Drag
- **Viewer: fit to screen** — `F`
- **Viewer: toggle info** — `I`
- **Viewer: rename** — `R`
- **Viewer: trash** — `Delete`
- **Viewer: close** — `Escape`

---

## Requirements

1. Minecraft 26.1 or newer (tested on 26.1.2 and 26.2)
2. Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer
3. Fabric API
4. Java 25 or newer

> This is a **client-side** mod. It is not required on servers.
